title: Ijwi ryo mu musenyi wa kera
intro: Mu ntumwa za mbere za Allah, hariho umwe izina ryiwe rikayangana muri make ariko rifise insiguro muri Korowani. Uwo muntu yabayeho kera cane imbere y’uko abahanuzi benshi bakomeye barungikwa, kandi yari azwi ko ari ukuri n’ukwihangana bidahungabana. Inkuru yabo ni ngufi ariko iragi ryabo rigumaho mu nyandiko y’ibihe bidahera. None uwo mutima w’icubahiro ni nde?
clues: Ndi umwe mu ntumwa za mbere, zivugwa muri make ariko zifise insiguro muri Korowani.
Inyifato yanje yasobanuwe n’ukwiyemeza ukuri ata gukeka.
Ndibuka mu gitabu ca Allah mu bari bashikamye kandi bihanganye.
Imirongo mikeyi gusa yo muri Korowani ni yo ivuga inkuru yanje.
Allah yaranteye iteka mu buryo bwihariye, ntasangiye n’abandi bahanuzi.
Narakuzwe mu kibanza co hejuru, icubahiro kidasanzwe muri Korowani.

trial.label: Gusobanura umwanya
options: Naduzwe ku kibanza co hejuru na Allah
Narubatse ubwato bunini bwo gukiza abantu banje .
Naratakaje amaso kubera umubabaro nari mfise kubera umuhungu wanje .
trial.answer: Naduzwe ku kibanza co hejuru na Allah

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
